$comment: Coverage policy for release gate G2 (doc/dev-notes/v2.4.0-requirements.md). check_coverage_gate.py enforces the floor and regression tolerance on the filtered report; the floor is a ratchet just below the measured combined coverage and may only rise, towards the G2 release minimum of 60%. summarize_coverage.py applies the exclusions: each needs a reason, patterns are fnmatch globs on repository-relative paths ('*' also crosses '/'), and one that matches no tracked or reported file is an error.

exclusions.reason: Generated in the build tree by Qt AUTOMOC/AUTOUIC/AUTORCC; not maintained source, not in the repository, and not mappable by Codecov.
